about.s6: We focus on authentic products, available from trusted companies in aquarium equipment and supplies
about.s8: We deliver to all 18 Iraqi governorates. Delivery within 24 hours only — 5,000 IQD for all Iraq.
about.s10: We are aquarium hobbyists before we were a store. We understand your needs because we share the same hobby and experience the same challenges.
about.s12: We provide educational content and practical support to help hobbyists choose equipment and care for their tank calmly and clearly.
about.s14: We commit to sustainable practices and encourage preserving natural aquatic environments through healthy tanks and energy‑efficient equipment.
about.s16: We aim to build a community of aquarium hobbyists in Iraq who share experiences and practical tips.
about.s28: AQUAVO is an Iraqi online store specializing in aquarium equipment and supplies, offering authentic products as available and hands‑on guidance for hobbyists.
about.s37: AQUAVO (AQUAVO) is an Iraqi online store specializing in aquarium equipment and supplies. We operate from Baghdad and serve aquarium hobbyists with delivery across Iraq and cash on delivery. We offer a specialized range of authentic products as available, including tanks, filters, heaters, lighting, foods, décor, and water treatments, along with educational content and practical support for choosing the right gear.
about.s39: AQUAVO began from a genuine passion for the aquarium world in Iraq. We noticed that hobbyists in Baghdad and other governorates struggled to find high‑quality aquarium supplies at reasonable prices. Local stores offer limited options, and buying abroad is costly and complicated.
about.s40: From there, the idea of AQUAVO was born—a specialized Iraqi online store for aquarium equipment and supplies. We launched the store in Baghdad in 2024 with a clear vision: to make aquarium setup easier and clearer for Iraqi hobbyists, from the beginner setting up their first tank to the enthusiast building a tidy aquascape.
about.s41: Today, AQUAVO serves aquarium hobbyists across all 18 Iraqi governorates, offering a specialized range of premium products from trusted brands as available. We focus on products and knowledge together—through an educational blog, setup and maintenance guides, calculation tools, and practical support.
about.s44: We provide everything a fish hobbyist in Iraq needs under one roof:
about.s46: AQUAVO’s mission is to make the fish hobby accessible and sustainable for everyone in Iraq. We believe a fish tank is more than décor—it’s a window into a magical aquatic world that brings calm and beauty to your daily life. We strive to be the trusted partner for every Iraqi hobbyist on their fish journey.

sustainability.s4: Our responsibility is to protect this beauty forever.
sustainability.s9: When you look at your tank, you’re not just seeing fish swimming. You’re witnessing a precise ecological system, a masterpiece crafted by nature over millions of years. Every fish is an ambassador of a mysterious and enchanting world.
sustainability.s11: we believe that the hobby of fishkeeping should be a force for good. A force that protects coral reefs, not destroys them. A force that preserves biodiversity, not depletes it.
sustainability.s12: "Nature is not a place we visit; it is our home."
sustainability.s14: Profit is not our sole goal. We are committed to giving back to the planet that gives us all this beauty.

sustainability.s25: Sustainability is not a slogan; it’s small daily decisions that make a big difference.

sustainability.s32: We carefully select our equipment. The filters and lighting we sell consume up to 50% less energy compared to conventional gear, reducing your bill and carbon emissions.
sustainability.s36: Every choice you make in your hobby leaves an impact. Choose to make your impact greener. Join us on a journey to turn our tanks into small oases of life, not just decoration.
